For attorneys, accredited representatives and advocates

Immigration Papers Reader

Built by Mobile Pathways, a tech nonprofit, to help you make sense of a client’s papers. Upload notices, FOIA responses, or court records, and we’ll read every page, pull out the dates, flag what’s missing, and draft common motions. We can also help you explain the case in words a child, a family, or your client will understand.

This isn’t legal advice.
